prompts.prompt: Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: HealthGoals art direction research, landscape editorial board, Spanish labels, adult optimistic visual taste, NOT a phone/app screen or dashboard. No teal/cream palette, rings, gauges, mascots, cards, medical graphs, daily quotas, days, badges, confetti. Opaque expressive content, native glass solely for controls. Conceptual imagery and annotations; no claim of working UI. Create a beautiful color-research board with THREE radically different palette families, each with swatches, light/dark background studies and ONE small abstract three-reference data sculpture repeated for comparison, not a final design system. Family F1 'COBALTO / BRASA': Pasos cobalt #2954D1, Actividad burnt orange #D45A32, light optical blue-white #F7F8FC, dark navy #131A2B, accent periwinkle #94A9FE. Family F2 'VIOLETA / MANDARINA': Pasos violet #7954E8, Actividad orange #EE6A18, light true white #FFFFFF, dark #201D25, accent #C9C1FF. Family F3 'BAYA / SOL': Pasos berry #B22F68, Actividad saffron yellow #E5AD1A, light #FFF5FA, dark aubergine #281522, accent #F2A3C6. Show stable hue for each metric across BELOW/AT/AHEAD states; use outlined/dashed/solid topology, no red/green moral traffic light. Include a small woven blue/saffron alternate experiment for the ENTREL AZAR direction but don't add a fourth main family. Colors are provisional studies, no tokens, no contrast-certification claims. Exact labels familyID, Pasos, Actividad, Light, Dark, Acento. Render visually precise swatches and beautiful light/dark art pair per family.

Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: HealthGoals art direction research, landscape editorial board, Spanish labels, adult optimistic visual taste, NOT a phone/app screen or dashboard. No teal/cream palette, rings, gauges, mascots, cards, medical graphs, daily quotas, days, badges, confetti. Opaque expressive content, native glass solely for controls. Conceptual imagery and annotations; no claim of working UI. Create a professional art-direction material-layer exploded reference sheet. Left two thirds: 'CONTENIDO PROPIO' with four different large opaque art fragments (folded cobalt paper, violet/orange printed imprint, berry/yellow tesserae, blue/saffron woven textile) that EACH show actual solid quantity, independent habitual dashed witness and outer empty target. Label native glass controls only in right third: 'UI NATIVA / MATERIAL CONCEPTUAL': neutral translucent navigation/back control; short toolbar group; contextual pencil/ellipsis tied by leader to the corresponding opaque metric fragment; numerical edit field on an OPAQUE legible background with native cancel/check controls; a small overlay-sheet sample on a plain base; a single floating action. No whole screen composition. Make an exploded side elevation at bottom where glass control plane is above but separate from opaque data-content plane, respecting separation, never glass over glass, never hiding numbers. Show 'REDUCIR TRANSPARENCIA' alternate opaque control at far bottom right with the same meaning. Include the distinction content shape/data/color vs native navigation/actions/edit/overlay. No product feature invention. Native material is schematic NOT an exact iOS screenshot. White/graphite neutral backdrop.

Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: HealthGoals art direction research, landscape editorial board, Spanish labels, adult optimistic visual taste, NOT a phone/app screen or dashboard. No teal/cream palette, rings, gauges, mascots, cards, medical graphs, daily quotas, days, badges, confetti. Opaque expressive content, native glass solely for controls. Create a clean VISUAL STORYBOARD plate, 6 rows by 3 temporal keyframes, of one asymmetric woven-blue data object with dashed habitual stitch and open final target mesh. Each row must have clearly different before/intermediate/after images, labelled 1/2/3; no UI screen. Row1 'ACTUALIZAR': real22.000->24.000, expected21.500 and meta40.000 fixed, corresponding remaining18.000->16.000; move only actual front from55% to60%, show an interpolation sketch not a new reading. Row2 'RELACION': same real24.000, habitual21.500 reference comes into clear visible dashed focus, do not move real, no extra progress. Row3 'COMPLETAR': real39.600->40.600 meta40.000, fill clamped100%, remaining400->0, show actual40.600 and short check; no celebration or target increase. Row4 'ANADIR / RETIRAR': single blue Pasos fabric->two separate blue Pasos and saffron Actividad fabrics->single blue fabric again, no shared state, no merging of units. Row5 'EDITAR': stable opaque amount label40.000->same label becomes inline numerical field with pencil/check/cancel controls->committed or canceled stable label; demonstrate continuity of origin, no new Home. Row6 'REDUCE MOTION': same initial and final data immediately replaced, an '=' or static arrow between snapshots, no translation/scale/sweep/counting; same state semantics. Keep drawings much larger than small annotations. Matte woven fibers, high readability, adult contemporary. Finite transitions only on real data, no loops, no fake zero. This sheet is only concept keyframes, not an animation or native-test evidence.
